subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Corporate Compliance Programs
description: A quick, practical guide to Corporate Compliance Programs.

hook.text: A company discovers fraud. The DOJ asks: did you have a compliance program? If yes, the penalty is lighter.

buildup.text: Effective compliance programs include ethics training, hotlines, risk assessments, and clear policies.

discovery.text: DOJ guidelines reward companies with genuine compliance programs through reduced fines and deferred prosecution.

twist.text: Many compliance programs exist on paper but lack resources, authority, or real management support.

climax.text: A compliance program is only as good as the culture behind it. Paper programs don't prevent fraud.

punchline.text: Real compliance reduces fines and fraud. Paper compliance does neither.

quiz.question: How does the DOJ reward effective compliance programs?
options: Through reduced fines and deferred prosecution
